Are 18-gene T-cell–inflamed GEP associated with treatment response?

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
expr <- readRDS("../data/processed/filtered_counts.rds")
d <- readRDS("../data/processed/imvigor210_prepared.rds")
meta <- d$clinical
```

First we check that none of the genes of interest where cut in the preprocessing

```{r}
#| label: calculate-gep

GEP_genes <- c(
"CD27", "CD274", "PDCD1", "CD276", "CD8A", "CMKLR1",
"CXCL9", "CXCR6", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-E",
"IDO1", "LAG3", "NKG7", "PDCD1LG2", "PSMB10", "STAT1",
"TIGIT"
)

GEP_genes %in% rownames(expr)
```

```{r}
expr_GEP <- expr[rownames(expr) %in% GEP_genes, ]
expr_GEP_scaled <- expr_GEP |>
  t() |>
  scale() |>
  t()
GEP_score_response <- data.frame(
  pat_id = colnames(expr_GEP_scaled),
  GEP_score = colMeans(expr_GEP_scaled)
) |>
  inner_join(meta, by = "pat_id")

GEP_score_response |> head()
```

To see if there is an effect we can make a regression model, or make a threshold and compare groups. We make a boxplot and histogram to see if there is are clear groups

```{r}
GEP_hist <- ggplot(GEP_score_response, aes(x = GEP_score)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 16,
    fill = "darkgrey",
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of GEP scores",
    x = "GEP-score",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) 

ggsave('../results/plots/RQ2_Histogram_GEP.png', GEP_hist)
GEP_hist

```

From the ammount of outliers and a clear island in the histogram we conclude there is a meaningful grouping of high and low GEP scoring groups. The sizes of these groups are however very different, and that should be kept in mind whilst comparing

```{r}
wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(GEP_score ~ BOR, data = GEP_score_response)
wilcox_test
```

```{r}
plot_Response_boxplot <- function(data, variable, y_label, test_result) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = BOR, y = .data[[variable]], fill = BOR)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = BOR), width = 0.12, alpha = 1) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("p = ", signif(test_result$p.value, 3)),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Response class",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
Responseplot <- plot_Response_boxplot(GEP_score_response, "GEP_score", "T cell-inflamed GEP score", wilcox_test)
ggsave('../results/plots/RQ2_response_GEP.png', Responseplot)
Responseplot
```

Export results and analysis for dowstream steps

```{r}
GEP_score_response |> saveRDS('../data/processed/RQ2_GEP_scores_with_meta.rds')

```
